query_snapshot: Which alloy and heat-treatment conditions does NASA SP-8119 identify as susceptible to stress corrosion in its material-compatibility discussion?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 lists aluminum alloy 2014 in the T4 condition among materials identified as susceptible to stress corrosion in the material-compatibility discussion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists aluminum alloy 2024 in the T3 condition (2024-T3) among materials identified as susceptible to stress corrosion in the material-compatibility discussion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists PH15-7Mo with heat treatments RH950 and TH1050 as susceptible to stress corrosion in the material-compatibility discussion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists 17-7PH in the annealed condition as susceptible to stress corrosion in the material-compatibility discussion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists 17-4PH with heat treatments RH950 and TH1050 as susceptible to stress corrosion in the material-compatibility discussion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists AM350 with heat treatment SCT850 as susceptible to stress corrosion in the material-compatibility discussion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists AM355 with heat treatment SCT850 as susceptible to stress corrosion in the material-compatibility discussion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
